text.en:
This expansion area of the townsite of the Municipality of Luna, Province of Kalinga-Apayao
shall be named and officially referred to as "BARO A KAGIMONGAN."

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 7th day of February, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-seven.
